title: Executable Research Claim (ERC)
description: Charter §14: ERC = <H, A, F, E, V>. The primitive scientific unit in EDS.

id.description: Content-addressed or stable slug identifier for this ERC.

artifact.description: A: the executable artifact operationalizing the hypothesis.

reference.description: repo/path/commit or issue URL identifying the artifact.

source_revision.description: Exact SHA, never a symbolic ref.

falsifier.description: F: an observation which, if made, reduces or destroys the claim's standing. May be empty ONLY if no_falsifier is true.

no_falsifier.description: Charter §7: NoFalsifier => NoStrongEDSClaim. Must be true when falsifier is empty or not yet constructed — never silently omitted.

evidence.description: E: real execution evidence gathered (command + output), or an explicit statement that none was gathered.

verification.description: V: verdict of the verification procedure — must not assert more than the evidence supports.

evidence_state.description: Charter §8 closed evidence-state vocabulary. Must not collapse distinct states.

receipt_refs.description: IDs of eds Receipts (see receipt.schema.json) backing this ERC's evidence_state.

allOf.description: Charter §8/§9: a state above EXECUTABLE requires real evidence to exist on the record, not just be claimed.
